original_observations.gate_scope: Complete per-test FAIL block extracted from the then-running r14 log prefix, not a full-gate terminal receipt.

failure_location_distinction: The dedicated background Apps reconnect loop has a five-second timeout and a different panic location/message. The observed ten-second generic wait panic is compatible with TestCodex.submit_turn waiting for TurnStarted after a normal NotSubmitted response; the raw failure block does not identify which submit_turn invocation timed out.

source_chain.finding: After RefreshMcpServers, the fixture starts a turn and reads raw events until TurnComplete and Apps Ready. It then immediately calls submit_turn for the follow-up without observing completion of the exact normal turn finish owner.

Finish ownership is registered before terminal work. TurnComplete is sent/flushed before the terminalization marker is cleared, recovery and idle/pending-work publication completes, and finish_task_terminalization retires the owner.

StartOrSteer does not await a finish owner. A pending active terminalizer or admission fence can produce Ok(TurnInputSubmission::NotSubmitted { reason: NotIdle }); no follow-up is enqueued and no TurnStarted is promised.

The fixture helper propagates only the Result error and discards the normal submission enum, then waits for TurnStarted. The generic helper already documents and observes exact normal-turn completion when it itself receives TurnComplete, but this test bypasses it with next_event for the second turn.

pending_normal_turn_finish_completion snapshots completion handles only for Finish-kind owners matching the observed normal TurnComplete ID. Awaiting this observer grants no admission authority, changes no owner, and cannot accidentally wait for an aborted/recovered lineage.

MCP readiness/startup work is separate from the task finish registry. A server Ready event cannot stand in for normal-turn finish-owner retirement. The controlled server decrements one requested initialization failure; candidate does not touch that failure injection or startup retry code.

proposed_fix: In this test only, capture and await pending_normal_turn_finish_completion when the original raw loop observes normal TurnComplete; set turn_complete only afterward. Keep this await inside the pre-existing five-second reconnect timeout and retain the Apps Ready condition.
evidence_limits: The source establishes a reachable race and explains the observed generic ten-second wait shape; no event/admission trace or backtrace identifies the precise branch taken by the failing native process.
No claim is made that the native follow-up returned NotSubmitted in this particular run until the unchanged native gate is rerun with the candidate.
No product MCP startup, OAuth, tool visibility, routing, authority, error handling, owner retirement, or retry behavior is changed.
No new sleep, retry, turn resubmission, timeout increase, skip, filter, fixture failure suppression, or test assertion weakening is introduced.
